_comment: Hand-edited. Organisers' own pages, read directly (item 72, §3.Z). type: ics = an iCalendar feed; apidae-ot = the tourist office list + event pages, parsed without AI; page = HTML or RSS read and extracted by Gemini WITHOUT grounding. follow = a path pattern: the list page is read, then each linked event page matching it (up to maxFollow, default 25). enabled:false keeps a site on file with the reason it is not read.

sources.name: Office de tourisme du Pays de Fontainebleau
Ville de Fontainebleau
sources.note: Answers HTTP 418 to GitHub Actions (cloud addresses blocked) while answering normally elsewhere. Not worked around: the site decides who reads it.

sources.name: ANVL (naturalistes)
sources.note: Only the RSS feed is read. The outings live solely in a 'Booking Activities' calendar whose public data request (admin-ajax, allowed by robots.txt) answers 404 to an identified robot — not worked around. No sitemap entry per outing. Ask ANVL (phase 72c) for the plugin's .ics export link: two clicks in its admin.

sources.name: Espaces équestres Henson
sources.note: No agenda: the outings at Henson – Pays de Fontainebleau (Saint-Martin-en-Bière) are sold as shop offers. The 'Évènement' tag page was a news archive for every Henson centre.
